messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2 > 10s for 3m, SLO breach. Auto-incident created. Paging priya (oncall).
priya (oncall): on it. joining bridge now. pinging eng-runtime and eng-router.
marta (eng-runtime): joining. seeing streaming stalls in kstream consumer metrics, p95 also degraded ~1.8s. any customer impact yet?
lucy (customer-success): Support flagged two customers in us-west-2 reporting timeouts on streaming connections ~5m ago. IDs: cust-428, cust-551.
jamal (sre): I see router error spikes and increased queue depth on router pods in west-2-a. Labels show a hot-partition key set; also connection errors to backend pool.
alec (eng-router): digging into routing table snapshots. I pulled the shard assignments; looks like routing policy weights for weight-set alpha were incorrectly applied after the last rollout. A subset of routers is sending ~60% of traffic to 2 hot GPU hosts.
priya (oncall): can we confirm if fallback policies were triggered? deploy-bot: fallback policy check — CANARY fallbacks currently disabled for this route.
marta (eng-runtime): that explains tail. If a few hosts are overloaded, KV cache misses + rehydration cause streaming stalls and high p99. Recommend enabling eager fallback to compatible variant or adjust routing weights.
alec (eng-router): command I'm running to inspect affected routers:
```
kubectl -n router get pods -l region=us-west-2 -o wide | xargs -I{} kubectl exec -n router {} -- curl -s localhost:6060/debug/routing/table
```
jamal (sre): I can push a local routing override to redistribute traffic. Plan: reduce weight on weight-set alpha by 50% and enable fallback to small-model-quantized for streaming sessions in that region.
priya (oncall): do it. push change and watch p99. Please confirm rollback plan.
alec (eng-router): applying override now: `routectl set-weight --region=us-west-2 --set=alpha --factor=0.5 --meta=incident-1734567890`
deploy-bot: APPLY_OK: route override applied by alec at 1734567999.
jamal (sre): enabling eager fallback: `routectl set-fallback --route=/v1/generate --region=us-west-2 --variant=small-quant --enabled=true`
deploy-bot: APPLY_OK: fallback enabled.
marta (eng-runtime): seeing immediate drop in queue depth and KV-cache reuse improving. p95 down to 700ms, p99 trending down from 12s -> 3.2s.
priya (oncall): good. keep watch for 10m. alert thresholds still firing?
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 decreased to 3.1s (was 12.4s). still above target 1s, but improving.
lucy (customer-success): emailed cust-428 + cust-551 with mitigation note and ETA. customers acknowledged and appreciate the quick update.
alec (eng-router): root cause hypothesis: rollout script for routing policy v2 omitted normalization of weight vectors when reading feature flags. Under certain sampling, one weight-set could be amplified for a subset of routers (seed drift + regional config merge). I'll open PR for validation and a hotfix to normalize weights on read.
marta (eng-runtime): also noting our streaming KV cache warms are very sensitive to host churn; we should add a protective cap for cache eviction during hot reassigns.
jamal (sre): mitigation checklist:
- [x] route override applied
- [x] fallback enabled
- [x] notify customers
- [x] monitor p95/p99
- [ ] postmortem link + RCA
priya (oncall): confirming traffic 45m after mitigation is stable. p99 ~850ms, p95 ~180ms. Closing paging status to monitoring mode. I'll hand off to eng-router and eng-runtime for RCA & follow-up.
alec (eng-router): started a draft issue: "router: weight-normalization missing in v2 rollout -> hotpartition misroute" with logs and snapshot attached.
marta (eng-runtime): created follow-up task to add KV cache protective cap and to build a synthetic workload to surface this failure during canary.
lucy (customer-success): following up with impacted customers to offer credits and to gather logs for their sessions.
priya (oncall): thanks everyone. final note: we'll run an after-action in 48h. If anyone spots regression, ping this thread and reopen bridge. Closing now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 below threshold, mitigation active. Incident closed at 1734571020.
